title: carex pensylvanica subsp. heliophila
intro: Carex pensylvanica subsp. heliophila, commonly known as the Pennsylvania sedge or sun-loving sedge, is a subspecies of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is believed to contain flavonoids and other compounds with potential medicinal properties.
